note: User choices 2026-10-07, from the ground_states_mockup gallery (round 2). Sizes are tile units; scales multiply the Civ VI decal quads (100 source units per tile).

hut.note: Gallery hut option B: no 2.6x vertical stretch, each piece 1.7x where it stands, same village spread.

camp.note: Gallery camp option B: no vertical stretch, pieces 1.8x, ring pulled in 15%.

pollution.note: Every polluted tile, whatever the source (eruption, city, meltdown, nuke): ash and char.
pollution.round_note: The burnt-ground decals run to their square edges; over crops that read as a dark square, so the stack fades out round.

crater.note: Civ Royale blast craters, tuned: larger bowls, darker floors, a faint scorch. Drawn over pollution.
crater.sun_note: Relief is baked lit from the upper right of the screen (tile x right-down, y left-down), where the 1498 AD frames' sun stands; crater decals therefore never turn.

ruins.note: A razed city: the rubble field alone (gallery round 2, 'rubble decal only'; user choice 2026-10-07), in one of Civ III's three sizes. It follows the tile's ruins flag, as Civ III does.

lift_note: Ground states lie over a farm's crop fields (lift .016) and under route strips (6.5 height units), as Civ III draws pollution, craters and ruins over irrigation.
